title: POST /farm/queue — enqueue server-side generation (request + response)
description: A control-plane producer requests farm generation for a repair/manual folder or file target. The server stamps producer identity and splits kinds into independently scheduled server/render jobs. Automatic discovery uses the same internal enqueue contract without requiring this HTTP path.

path.description: Volume-relative path (mount_point stripped — the contract's nas_rel_path). A directory (recursive) or one file. This advanced repair/manual endpoint requires a non-empty target; automatic discovery does not require the operator to choose one.

kinds.description: derivatives = local-server tech + poster/thumbnail + filmstrip + waveform; proxy = verified hardware HEVC preferred, hardware H.264 second, CPU H.264 fallback; transcript = the fastest verified backend; all = three independently routed jobs.

options.description: Optional generation knobs; any omitted field ⇒ the worker's container default.
